title: Equipment mapping v1
description: One enabled mapping binds a tenant-scoped platform equipment UUID to one CMMS asset and one ThingsBoard device.
$comment: Cross-record uniqueness is enforced by platform-integration storage, not JSON Schema: (tenant_id, equipment_id), (tenant_id, cmms_asset_id), and (tenant_id, tb_device_id) are each unique. This contract contains only the approved enabled shape; RESERVED and ACTIVE are internal provisioning states.

cmms_asset_id.$comment: JSON integer token required at the platform-integration to CMMS boundary; standard Draft 2020-12 integer validation alone accepts integral floating-point values.
